text: 60% your 1RM. Do reps to form-failure. 3 sets. 2 different exercises. 3 times a week. After 6 to 10 weeks, genetics depending, your chest will be bigger. Repeat to desired size/strength.

text: 1. Eat more, its going to be very difficult to get to 100kg bench on a lean bulk or on a cut. 2. Like everyone said, add volume - finishers and burnouts with different exercises than what you did. 3. Hit relevant muscle groups - your pecs may be outgrowing the other muscles involved in the lift. Shoulders, triceps, and even Lats! - training those a bit won't give you results right away but if you focus on those groups for a while, say 2 months, when you come back to bench, you will be able to make gains once again.
